truth_boundary: This registry separates source-locked design inputs from model hypotheses and unresolved hardware quantities. No unresolved value may be silently promoted into a physical validation claim.

payload.design_intent: low central mount with raised sides and tie-down points

model_hypotheses_not_source_locked.track_width_note: Existing skid-steer software default only; must be replaced by CAD/as-built measurement.

required_unknowns_before_next_test_tranc: Exact Rhino IG52 manufacturer/supplier torque-speed curve for the selected part
Rated torque, stall torque, no-load/rated/stall current, gearbox efficiency, thermal and duty-cycle limits
MDDS30 configured current limits and protection behavior for the intended wiring
Battery/BMS continuous and peak current limits plus measured pack internal resistance/voltage sag
Final wheelbase, axle spacing, track width, rocker lengths, bogie lengths, pivot locations and ground clearance
Empty and +1 kg payload centre-of-mass coordinates from CAD or measured mass points
Tyre construction/compound and measured or source-backed traction coefficient on representative surfaces
Rolling resistance and skid-turn scrub resistance
Payload retention geometry, tie-down specification, fasteners and permitted payload displacement
Measured motor-enable/contact opening latency and wheel coast/braking profile
Jetson, camera, LiDAR, radio and DC/DC branch power/current budgets
Sensor mounting poses and fields of view for perception/navigation simulation

governance.reason: User explicitly requested that the next test tranche wait for additional hardware/context information.
